serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Landlord: Hello Anon!
Landlord: I hope you remember about our agreement. Hehe~
Landlord: Your rent is {gv_BotDiscoveryRentIncreaseValue}$ more.
You: Of course, I remembered.
Landlord: Of course? You’d be surprised how many tenants pretend they forgot and start crying the moment I appear.
You: Increasing rent is such a common occurrence?
Landlord: Of course! Have you been living in some kind of fairyland?! 
Landlord: Checked the inflation rate lately? Our precious government is printing so much money that soon we will be milked dry!
You: Riiiiight. I agree.
I don’t want to turn this into a sermon. Let’s get it over with.
You: Here’s the money.
